description: FtTextMetrics' face lookup reproduces the host GDI's choice for Font::create's LOGFONTA by a MEASURED rule (log/roadmap/S5/1_gdi_probe.log, 1_gdi_probe2.log): a face whose family name (name ID 1) equals lfFaceName case-insensitively, the closest in italic then weight; else a face whose full name (name ID 4) equals it when the face is the only one of its family (Manual SSi Bold, Unispace-Bold and Cascadia Code Regular resolve that way; Arial Bold, Times New Roman Bold, Comic Sans MS Bold and Courier New Bold do not, although arialbd.ttf / timesbd.ttf / comicbd.ttf carry those full names, also with arialbd.ttf registered privately); else the substitute (U-1501). The rule fits all 15 FontRefs and the 17 probe queries; which faces GDI's mapper really aliases by full name (single-face families, the registry's font list, or another property) is not established, and the candidate list is the files of the font directories, not the registry's installed-font list.
path to resolution: Probe more families: a two-face family whose second face has a non-RIBBI subfamily, a font file present in the directory but not registered, a registered font outside the directory.

description: For a face no candidate matches (Arial Bold, Times New Roman Bold, Comic Sans MS Bold and any unknown name with OUT_TT_ONLY_PRECIS and lfCharSet 0), GDI on LIVING-PC substitutes the family Arial with the requested style (arial.ttf, ariali.ttf for lfItalic 1, arialbd.ttf for lfWeight 700: 1_gdi_probe2.log). FtTextMetrics hard-codes Arial as that substitute. Where GDI's mapper takes it from (the system's default TrueType sans, FontSubstitutes, the locale) is not established; a host with another default would pick another face, and a host without Arial makes four FontRefs (g_font51b320, g_fontRef_519fd8, g_font51b340, g_font519968) a MissingResource.
path to resolution: Probe on a host with another UI language or without Arial; read the font mapper's documentation of the OUT_TT_ONLY_PRECIS fallback.

description: Synthetic bold and italic: GDI's extents for Klepto ITC TT (a Roman-only face) at 18 / 24 with lfWeight 700 are one pixel per glyph wider and its five FontRef words unchanged; lfItalic 1 on a face without an italic changes neither (1_gdi_probe3.log). FtTextMetrics emboldens when the request is >= 600 and the face < 600 (+1 per glyph). Only the 700-on-400 case was measured; the threshold is not. No FontRef of the game asks for bold (style bit 0 is never set), so no recorded row depends on it.

The five FontRef words: tmAscent / tmDescent from VDMX (the first ratio group covering 1:1, record yPelHeight == ppem) when present, else OS/2 usWinAscent / usWinDescent scaled with FreeType's y_scale and rounded ((FT_MulFix + 32) >> 6); tmInternalLeading = tmAscent + tmDescent - ppem (measured: the scaled usWinAscent + usWinDescent - unitsPerEm form gave one less for Klepto 18 / 24 and Manual SSi 14, 1_metrics_x64_first.log); tmExternalLeading = max(0, scaled(hhea.lineGap - ((winAscent + winDescent) - (hhea.ascender - hhea.descender)))). The rule gives the original's and GDI's words for all 15 FontRefs (1_metrics_x64.log, 1_metrics_w32.log); it has not been checked on other faces or sizes (a VDMX group that does not hold the ppem, a negative scaled leading).
path to resolution: Compare over a sweep of faces and sizes with log/roadmap/S5/1_gdi_probe.py-style GDI queries.

description: The advance rule (fttext.cpp advance(), 1_rule_probe.log R3): hdmx width at the ppem; else the linear advance rounded half up when head flags bit 4 is clear or LTSH's yPels for the glyph is <= the ppem; else FreeType v35's hinted advance; the five code page 1252 bytes 0x81 0x8d 0x8f 0x90 0x9d measure 0. It equals GDI on 3,136 of 3,136 (byte 0x20..0xff, face, size) cases of the game's 14 face / size pairs. The hinted branch is reached only by Arial 9 / 10 / 18 glyphs whose LTSH yPels exceeds the ppem; v35 agreeing with GDI there is measured, not shown in general. Bytes below 0x20 are outside the rule: the recordings hold 22 rows of a lone 0x0a per table, whose result the original itself varies on (U-0960); FreeType gives its cmap glyph's advance, equal on 14 of 22, as the x64 GDI run.
path to resolution: Sweep other faces with hinted advances and no hdmx; probe GDI's 0x00..0x1f extents per face.

description: FreeType on LIVING-PC is vcpkg's freetype 2.14.3, triplets x64-windows and x86-windows, features core (no zlib, png, bzip2, brotli or harfbuzz dependency; the gzip / LZW modules use FreeType's bundled code), installed from a claude3 session on Mariano's approval (G4) in C:\Users\maria\vcpkg (log/roadmap/S5/vcpkg_install_freetype.log). Those triplets build freetype.dll, so portsim_c.dll and the Win32 runner need freetype.dll next to them (CMake copies it after each build). A static triplet (x64-windows-static-md, x86-windows-static-md) would remove the runtime file; not installed here (bootstrapping vcpkg tools was refused to this worker by the permission classifier).
path to resolution: The integrator decides: keep the DLL copy, or install the static-md triplets and drop the copy step.

description: MissingResource names are not visible through sg_call: SgError carries SG_E_NO_RESOURCE only, so the no-FreeType build's `MissingResource{"FreeType"}` is proven by the code and the error code (test_fttext.py::test_build_without_freetype), not by its text.
path to resolution: Expose the last MissingResource name in the C ABI (as sg_run_frames_detail does for runs) if the text matters.
